=== Jenkinsfile (groovy-declarative)
# Imported from Jenkinsfile by launchway import pipeline. The old files are untouched.
# Read the findings it printed: lines marked NEEDS A PERSON below are not converted.
pipeline: pipeline
on:
  push: {branches: ['*'], tags: ['*']}
steps:
  docker:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    env:
      MODE: ci
    run: |
      true
  pod:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: docker
    when: {event: schedule}
    env:
      MODE: ci
    run: |
      echo 'NEEDS A PERSON: the plug-in step mail ran here'; exit 1
  ok:
    image: docker.io/library/ubuntu:24.04
    needs: pod
    when: {event: pull_request}
    env:
      MODE: ci
    run: |
      echo ok
